text: Lotus’s Sukhumvit 50 is my go-to hypermarket in this part of Bangkok. The store is spacious, well-organised, and consistently well-stocked — whether you’re picking up fresh produce, household essentials, or grabbing a quick bite at the food court. Aisles are easy to navigate. Conveniently located near On Nut BTS, making it very accessible. Open until midnight, which is a real bonus. Highly recommended for both locals and visitors alike.

Lotus’s Sukhumvit 50 is a large and well-organized supermarket and lifestyle store located on Sukhumvit Road (Soi 50) in Bangkok. It offers a wide range of products to meet everyday needs, including:
Fresh fruits and vegetables
Meat and seafood
Groceries and household items
Ready-to-eat foods and snacks
Personal care products and daily essentials
The store layout is clean and spacious, making shopping comfortable and easy. There are plenty of checkout counters and friendly staff to assist customers. The supermarket also frequently offers special promotions and discounts, helping shoppers save money.
In addition to everyday items, Lotus’s Sukhumvit 50 has sections for home goods, electronics, and seasonal products, making it a convenient one-stop shopping destination for families, workers, and residents in the area.
Overall, Lotus’s Sukhumvit 50 is a reliable and convenient place for daily shopping and essential purchases. 🛒🛍️

I purchased some items using the self-service checkout. One item wasn't in the system, so I couldn't buy it initially. An assistant helped me, and that item appeared on the monitor as 'taken out.' After I finished the transaction, the machine alerted again, and two other assistants came over to help. I bagged everything and paid, but I noticed the 'deleted' item was still on the receipt. I calculated the total manually and realized I had been charged for it.

I went to customer service where a third assistant asked the first one what happened; she claimed it had been deleted because the system couldn't read it. I trusted them and went home. However, when I double-checked, I only had 12 items, but the receipt showed 13. The item was never actually deducted from my bill. Lesson learned: don't always trust the system; sometimes it's better to wait in the long queue.
Luckily for me its just small amount.

Honest Review – A Painful Experience at Lotus 😔

Our first visit to Lotus was okay, so before leaving Thailand, we decided to go back to buy some gifts for our kids and family. Sadly, that day turned into a heartbreaking experience. 💔

Our bag with the passport inside was stolen. We later learned from staff that there’s a lady known for robbing people, and she had been there that day. What shocked us most was that there were no CCTVs in many areas — there was no way to trace what happened.

Only two kind men tried to help us, but most of the staff didn’t assist, even when we tried to explain everything using our phone translator. I felt lost, scared, and alone in a foreign country, with only two days left before our flight — and no passport. 😢

Please, Lotus, improve your security and consider having translators available. No traveler should ever have to go through something like this.
